shortDescription: Manages the ADS authentication provider on PowerScale

options.name: ads_parameters
options.description: Specify additional parameters to configure ADS domain.

options.name: ads_password
options.description: Specifies the password used during domain join. This parameter is mandatory during create.

options.name: ads_user
options.description: Specifies the user name that has permission to join a machine to the given domain. This parameter is mandatory during create.

options.name: api_password
options.description: the password of the PowerScale cluster.

options.name: domain_name
options.description: Specifies the domain name of an Active Directory provider. This parameter is mandatory during create.

options.name: instance_name
options.description: Specifies the instance name of Active Directory provider. This is an optional parameter during create, and defaults to the provider name if it is not specified during the create operation. Get, modify and delete operations can also be performed through instance_name. It is mutually exclusive with I(domain_name) for get, modify and delete operations.

options.name: onefs_host
options.description: IP address or FQDN of the PowerScale cluster.

options.name: port_no
options.description: Port number of the PowerScale cluster.It defaults to 8080 if not specified.

options.name: spn_command
options.description: Specify command of SPN. C(check) - Check for missing SPNs for an AD provider. C(fix) - Adds missing SPNs for an AD provider.

options.name: state
options.description: The state of the ads provider after the task is performed. C(present) - indicates that the ADS provider should exist on the system. C(absent) - indicates that the ADS provider should not exist on the system.

options.name: verify_ssl
options.description: boolean variable to specify whether to validate SSL certificate or not. C(true) - indicates that the SSL certificate should be verified. C(false) - indicates that the SSL certificate should not be verified.
